name: Asyntai AI Chatbot
description: Adds the Asyntai AI chatbot to your site. It reads your pages and answers visitor questions 24/7.
author: Asyntai - asyntai.com

messageInOptions.text: Create a free account on asyntai.com, then copy your embed code from the Asyntai dashboard and paste it below. Change the chatbot's look, answers and language in the dashboard.

config.name: widgetId
config.label: Embed code or widget ID
config.note: Paste the whole embed code from your Asyntai dashboard, or only the widget ID. The plugin finds the ID in the code.

config.name: cookieBannerIntegration
config.label: Load the chatbot only after cookie consent
config.note: Uses Publii's built-in Cookie Banner. The chatbot loads only after the visitor accepts the Cookie Group below.

config.name: cookieBannerGroup
config.label: Cookie Group ID
config.note: The Cookie Group ID from Site Settings > Privacy (GDPR) > Cookie Banner, for example: functional
